images.filename: 2025-12-17 White House Ballroom construction Washington DC 11-27-41.jpg
images.caption: Construction of the White House State Ballroom on December 17, 2025.  The East Wing of the White House has been completely demolished and work at ground level is ongoing.  To the left of the construction site the edge of the White House is visible and behind the construction site is an enclosed walkway. 1600 Pennsylvania Avenue NW, Washington, D.C. 20500.
images.alt: Construction of the White House State Ballroom on December 17, 2025.  The East Wing of the White House has been completely demolished and work at ground level is ongoing.  To the left of the construction site the edge of the White House is visible and behind the construction site is an enclosed walkway. 1600 Pennsylvania Avenue NW, Washington, D.C. 20500.
